title: Harvester Dataset Provenance
description: Per-dataset provenance record. One provenance file per dataset per release, located at <release_root>/provenance/<dataset_id>.provenance.json. Records the full acquisition and transformation history, including failed attempts, for audit purposes.

schema_version.description: Provenance schema version, MAJOR.MINOR. Phase 2 freezes at 1.0.

method.description: How the raw data was obtained. 'computed' indicates a derived dataset with no external acquisition.

source_identifier.description: Canonical identifier of the source: URL, file path, API endpoint, or upstream dataset reference.

started_at.description: Timestamp when the acquisition attempt sequence started.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the final successful acquisition completed.

operator.description: Identifier of the human or automated agent that performed the acquisition.

attempts.description: Append-only record of all acquisition attempts including failed ones. Required if more than one attempt was made.

raw_path.description: Path under data/raw/ where the unmodified source bytes are stored. Out-of-scope for consumers; recorded for audit only.

processed_path.description: Path under data/processed/ if intermediate processing artifacts are kept.

internal_reference.description: References to provider-internal storage. NOT consumer-visible. Audit use only.

step.description: Sequence number of the transformation step.

name.description: Short identifier for this transformation step.

code_reference.description: Reference to the code that performed the transformation, e.g. 'harvester.providers.nfci:parse_v2' or a git commit + path.

params.description: Parameters passed to the transformation. Free-form.

input_sha256.description: sha256 of the input to this step, if applicable.

output_sha256.description: sha256 of the output of this step, if applicable.

transformations.description: Ordered list of transformations applied between raw acquisition and the final data file. Empty array is valid (raw == final).

raw_sha256.description: sha256 of the originally acquired bytes, before any transformation.

final_sha256.description: sha256 of the final data file. MUST match the dataset manifest's data_file.sha256.
